svg.title: Blue on Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; interpretive screen colour not calibrated. Museum-classified painted-aluminum painting. Two blue supports, backing rectangle and curved overlay, use distinguishable interpretive blues. Cast shadows omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://collections.lacma.org/object/33895; source object M.74.142; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
